question: I just joined as an LTV driver, how long is my probation?
expected_answer: 6 months. Driver probation includes a road assessment by the Fleet Supervisor before the end of month 4.
evidence: Probation for HTV and LTV drivers is 6 months. It includes a road assessment by the Fleet Supervisor before the end of month 4

question: can i take 3 casual leaves back to back for a family thing?
expected_answer: No. No more than 2 consecutive days of casual leave may be taken.
evidence: No more than 2 consecutive days may be taken.

question: is there a cap on how much overtime I can do, and what's the rate?
expected_answer: Overtime is paid at 2x hourly basic salary and is limited to 2 hours per day and 12 hours per week. It applies to G1-G2 only and must be pre-approved on Form HR-04.
evidence: Overtime is limited to 2 hours per day and 12 hours per week.

question: what happens if I come in late a few times in a month?
expected_answer: There is a 15-minute grace period. Three late arrivals beyond the grace period in one calendar month are recorded as 0.5 day casual leave; if no casual leave is left, the 0.5 day is unpaid.
evidence: Three late arrivals beyond the grace period in one calendar month are recorded as 0.5 day casual leave.

question: I've worked here for 2 years. If I go for Hajj now, will the leave be paid?
expected_answer: No. Hajj leave (up to 30 calendar days, once in service) is paid only with at least 3 years' continuous service on the first day of leave. With 2 years, it can be taken as unpaid leave.
evidence: Hajj leave is paid only for employees with at least 3 years' continuous service on the first day of leave.

question: my annual leave in November got rejected because of work. do I just lose those days at year end?
expected_answer: Not necessarily. If annual leave requested between 1 October and 31 December is refused in writing for operational reasons and the refusal is recorded in HRIS, up to 10 days (instead of the normal 7) can be carried forward. The extra days must be used by 30 June.
evidence: may carry forward up to 10 days (instead of 7) into the next leave year. The extra days must be used by 30 June.

question: How many days off can I get for my university exams?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: Does the company have a provident fund or gratuity? What percentage do they put in?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: A vendor who's quoting for our new tender wants to take me to dinner. Is that ok if it's under 10k?
expected_answer: No. No gift or hospitality of any value may be accepted from a vendor taking part in an open tender or quotation process, from the request date until the contract is awarded.
evidence: No gift or hospitality of any value may be accepted from a vendor taking part in an open tender or quotation process with the Company

question: got a show cause notice today, how many days do I have to reply?
expected_answer: 3 working days, in writing. The reply period can be extended once by 2 working days on request.
evidence: the employee replies in writing within 3 working days. The reply period may be extended once by 2 working days on request.

question: I want to report something but it's about the HR Manager. Who do I go to?
expected_answer: It can be sent directly to the COO in a sealed envelope marked 'Confidential - Speak-Up'. This applies to concerns involving the HR Manager or the Finance Manager.
evidence: If a concern involves the HR Manager or the Finance Manager, it may be sent directly to the COO in a sealed envelope

question: A customer sent me a box of Eid mithai worth around 7,000. Do I have to declare it?
expected_answer: No. Eid perishable gift boxes (sweets, fruit, dry fruit) up to PKR 8,000 may be accepted without declaration.
evidence: Eid perishable gift boxes (sweets, fruit, dry fruit) | Up to 8,000 | May accept; no declaration

question: I've been suspended pending an inquiry and it's dragging past two weeks. Do I still get full salary?
expected_answer: Suspension is on full pay for up to 14 calendar days. Beyond 14 days it needs COO approval and is on 50% basic salary, unless the delay is caused by the Company.
evidence: Extension beyond 14 days requires COO approval and is on 50% basic salary, unless the delay is caused by the Company.

question: Are we allowed to join a labour union?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: Do I get a bonus if I refer a friend who gets hired?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: For a night trip, at what distance do we need two drivers?
expected_answer: Night trips with a total route distance of more than 400 km must be double-crewed.
evidence: Night trips with a total route distance of more than 400 km must be double-crewed.

question: I think I lost the fuel card at a pump, what do I do?
expected_answer: Report it to the Control Room (ext. 222) within 2 hours of discovering the loss so the card can be blocked, then submit Form FLT-04 within 24 hours.
evidence: Report to the Control Room within 2 hours of discovering the loss, so the card can be blocked.

question: Are driving hours different in Ramadan?
expected_answer: Yes. On day routes, maximum driving per day is reduced to 8 hours. Fasting drivers must take a break of at least 45 minutes at iftar, and drivers must not be driving during the 30 minutes before iftar.
evidence: During Ramadan, the maximum driving time per day on day routes is reduced to 8 hours.

question: fog is really bad on the motorway, when exactly do I have to stop?
expected_answer: When visibility falls below 50 m: stop at the nearest safe point (fuel station, approved stop or service area), switch on hazard lights and inform the Control Room. Driving may resume only when visibility exceeds 100 m.
evidence: If visibility falls below 50 m, the driver must stop at the nearest safe point

question: What's the minimum tyre tread on the front steer axle for the pre-trip check?
expected_answer: At least 4 mm, with no cuts or bulges. Failing it is a Category A defect, so the vehicle must not leave.
evidence: Tyres – steer axle | Tread at least 4 mm; no cuts or bulges | A

question: Is there a per-km bonus for long-haul drivers?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: how fast are forklifts allowed to go inside?
expected_answer: 8 km/h in the warehouse and yard; 5 km/h in loading bays and racking aisles.
evidence: 8 km/h in the warehouse and yard; 5 km/h in loading bays and racking aisles.

question: can I lift a 30 kg carton on my own?
expected_answer: No. A single person must not lift any item heavier than 25 kg. Items between 25 kg and 50 kg need two people; above 50 kg they must be moved mechanically.
evidence: A single person must not lift any item heavier than 25 kg. Items between 25 kg and 50 kg require two people.

question: Can I take FL-01 into the racking aisles to grab a pallet quickly?
expected_answer: No. FL-01 is a diesel counterbalance forklift, and diesel forklifts must not enter the racking aisles or the warehouse interior beyond the yellow line at the back of the loading bays, because of exhaust fumes.
evidence: Diesel forklifts must not enter the racking aisles or the warehouse interior beyond the yellow line at the back of the loading bays

question: I got my forklift authorisation last week. Can I operate on a shift when no supervisor is on the floor?
expected_answer: No. For the first 20 shifts, a newly authorised operator (including a probationer) may operate only during shifts when a Warehouse Supervisor is on the floor.
evidence: may operate only during shifts when a Warehouse Supervisor is on the floor, for the first 20 shifts.

question: what PPE do I need at the battery charging station?
expected_answer: Hi-vis vest, safety shoes, acid-resistant gloves, a face shield or goggles, and an apron.
evidence: Battery charging station | ✔ | ✔ | — | Acid-resistant gloves | Face shield or goggles, apron

question: What temperature do cold-chain goods have to be stored at in the warehouse?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: Who runs the forklift training course and how much does it cost?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: If a driver has an accident about 400 km from Lahore, does the drug test still have to be within 4 hours?
expected_answer: No. For drivers more than 150 km from Lahore, the test is carried out within 8 hours at the nearest approved laboratory or hospital arranged by the Control Room. Medical treatment always comes first.
evidence: For drivers more than 150 km from Lahore, the test is carried out within 8 hours

question: after a small crash a crowd started getting aggressive. was I allowed to drive off?
expected_answer: Yes. If there is a risk of violence from a crowd, leave as soon as it is safe, drive to the nearest police station or approved stop and inform the Control Room. Leaving under these conditions is not a breach of the procedure.
evidence: If there is a risk of violence from a crowd, leave the scene as soon as it is safe

question: How long does the investigation take after a fatal accident?
expected_answer: A fatality is Level 4. Level 4 investigations must be completed within 21 calendar days, with an interim report to the COO within 7 days.
evidence: Level 4 investigations must be completed within 21 calendar days. An interim report goes to the COO within 7 days.

question: A pallet of customer goods worth about 7.5 lakh got damaged in the bay. What severity level is that?
expected_answer: Level 2 (Moderate): cargo damage of PKR 100,000-1,000,000 falls in Level 2, unless another factor (such as an injury) puts it at a higher level.
evidence: 2 | Moderate | Medical treatment beyond first aid; lost time of 1–3 days; property damage PKR 50,000–500,000; cargo damage PKR 100,000–1,000,000

question: A forklift scraped a wall at 2 am on Sunday, about PKR 10,000 damage, nobody hurt. Do we have to wake up the HSE Manager?
expected_answer: No. This is a Level 1 incident. For incidents between 23:00 and 07:00 or on Sundays and public holidays, Level 1 and 2 incidents may be escalated to the HSE Manager by 09:00 on the next working day. Only Level 3 and 4 must be escalated within 2 hours at any time.
evidence: Level 1 and 2 incidents during these periods may be escalated to the HSE Manager by 09:00 on the next working day.

question: Which hospitals in Lahore are on the company's panel for accident cases?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: do I have to change my email password every 3 months?
expected_answer: No. Only Finance/ERP and HRIS passwords must be changed every 90 days. Passwords for other systems are changed only when compromise is suspected or when IT requires it.
evidence: Passwords for other systems are changed only when compromise is suspected or when IT requires it.

question: I lost my company laptop again, second time this year. Will they cut my salary?
expected_answer: Yes. For a second loss within 24 months, 25% of the device's depreciated value is recovered from salary, up to a maximum of PKR 30,000, following the monthly recovery limit.
evidence: For a second loss within 24 months, or a loss caused by clear negligence, 25% of the device's depreciated value is recovered from salary

question: Can I paste a customer's rate sheet into an AI tool to summarise it?
expected_answer: No. Rate sheets are Confidential data. Confidential and Restricted data must not be entered into any AI tool unless the IT Manager has approved that specific use in writing.
evidence: Confidential and Restricted data must not be entered into any AI tool unless the IT Manager has approved that specific use in writing.

question: how long do they keep dashcam footage?
expected_answer: 30 days, then it is overwritten automatically. If linked to an incident, it is downloaded within 24 hours and kept as per IFL-SAF-005 §10.1.3.
evidence: Dashcam footage | 30 days (overwritten automatically)

question: Which AI tools are on IT's approved list?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: how long do I have to settle my cash advance after the trip?
expected_answer: Within 10 working days of the trip end date, by submitting Form FIN-01 and returning any unspent amount. Advances not settled within 30 days are recovered from the next salary.
evidence: Advances must be settled by submitting Form FIN-01 within 10 working days of the trip end date.

question: What's the deadline to submit my travel expense claim?
expected_answer: Within 15 calendar days of the trip end date (or of the expense date for non-travel claims). The 30-day deadline in v1.0 no longer applies.
evidence: Claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days of the trip end date

question: How much per km do I get if I use my own car for a company trip?
expected_answer: PKR 45 per km, based on the shortest practical route. Personal car use is allowed only if no Company vehicle is available and it is approved on FIN-02.
evidence: Mileage is reimbursed at PKR 45 per km, based on the shortest practical route.

question: I'm G3 and going from Karachi to Lahore for two nights next week, what's my hotel limit?
expected_answer: PKR 12,000 per night including taxes (G1-G3, major cities).

question: Who signs off on an expense claim of around 60k?
expected_answer: Department manager, then Finance Manager, then COO (claims above PKR 50,000). Claims by G4 managers go to the COO.
evidence: Above 50,000 | Department manager, then Finance Manager, then COO

question: I'm G3 and my Lahore hotel night was 28 June 2026. Which limit applies, 10k or 12k?
expected_answer: PKR 10,000. Expenses incurred up to and including 30 June 2026 are reimbursed at version 1.0 rates and limits, and the v1.0 G1-G3 major-city limit is PKR 10,000 per night.
evidence: Expenses incurred up to and including 30 June 2026 are reimbursed at version 1.0 rates and limits.

question: Do managers get a corporate credit card for travel?
expected_answer: NOT_IN_DOCUMENTS

question: My fuel card got declined on the road and the control room gave me a code to pay cash for diesel. How much can I spend and how long do I have to claim it?
expected_answer: Up to PKR 15,000 with the Control Room authorisation code. Claim it on Form FIN-01 under IFL-FIN-007 §8, which follows the general deadline in the current version (v2.0): within 15 calendar days of the trip end date. A receipt is required whatever the amount.
evidence: authorisation code for a cash purchase of up to PKR 15,000
Claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days of the trip end date

question: The company cancelled my approved leave because of an emergency and I'd already bought a non-refundable bus ticket. Can I get that money back, and is there a deadline?
expected_answer: Yes. The Company reimburses documented non-refundable travel costs, claimed on Form FIN-01 under IFL-FIN-007. Under the current policy (v2.0), claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days, and a receipt is needed for expenses above PKR 1,000.
evidence: The Company will reimburse any non-refundable travel costs the employee can document, on Form FIN-01 under IFL-FIN-007.
Claims must be submitted within 15 calendar days

question: I left my company laptop in a taxi during a business trip. Can I claim it on expenses, and what am I supposed to do?
expected_answer: No, it is not an expense claim; it is handled under the IT policy. Report the loss to the IT Helpdesk (or the Control Room outside office hours) within 2 hours of discovering it, and complete Form IT-03 within 24 hours. A first loss reported on time is not charged.
evidence: Loss of a Company laptop or phone during a trip is not an expense claim.
within 2 hours of discovering the loss

question: I'm an HTV driver on a 3-day run to Karachi. Do I get the meal per diem, and how much?
expected_answer: No per diem. Drivers get the out-of-station daily allowance instead (not both for the same day): PKR 2,500 per day for trips more than 150 km from the Lahore base, paid through the trip sheet, not FIN-01.
evidence: Drivers on Company trips receive the out-of-station daily allowance under IFL-HR-001 §10 instead of the meal per diem.
Out-of-station daily allowance | 2,500 per day
